run_gtest_output_test: run the googletest output test to compare actual test output against the golden file
generate_golden_file: generate a golden file by running gtest_output_test.py with the --gengolden flag
normalize_test_output: normalize googletest output by removing locations, stack traces, and time info for comparison
remove_stack_traces: remove all stack trace details from googletest program output using regex substitution
test_GTestOutputTest: test the GTestOutputTest class to verify googletest text output matches the golden file
